description.value: Kingfisher Pacific Resort & Spa is an award-winning oceanside resort on Vancouver Island offering rooms, suites, and penthouses alongside an acclaimed spa featuring Healing Caves and Hydropath wellness circuits. The property has earned recognition from Condé Nast Traveler, Travel + Leisure, and the BC Hotel of the Year Award among many others. Touring cyclists arriving here would find a polished coastal retreat with multiple on-site dining venues serving daily breakfast through dinner.

address.value: 4330 Island Highway South, Courtenay, BC V9N 9R9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms an active, award-winning oceanside resort on Vancouver Island with multiple on-site dining venues (Ocean7 Restaurant, AQUA Bistro & Wine Bar, Sky Domes Restaurant) offering daily meals including breakfast. The website title reads 'Kingfisher Pacific Resort & Spa' which differs from the OSM name 'Kingfisher Oceanside Resort & Spa' — flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Kingfisher Oceanside Resort & Spa' but the website header displays 'Kingfisher Pacific Resort & Spa'. The current operating name may be 'Kingfisher Pacific Resort & Spa'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, clearly active luxury resort on Vancouver Island with confirmed online presence, multiple dining options, and numerous recent awards. A legitimate stop for touring cyclists seeking upscale accommodation.
